summary.text: Tammy Simmons Garthwaite is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Carroll 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election; she defeated incumbent Brian R. Taylor in the September 8 Republican primary, finishing first among three candidates.

paragraphs.text: Citizens Count lists her as a Republican candidate for Carroll 8 who lives in East Wakefield, New Hampshire, is a retired former small business owner, and previously served in the New Hampshire House in 2010-2012 and 2014-2016.
Ballotpedia lists Simmons Garthwaite as the Republican candidate in Hillsborough 17 in 2018 and 2020 and in Hillsborough 19 in 2022, and she did not win in any of those general elections.
